title: [確認しよう] 条件を組み合わせる
statement: employees テーブルから department が sales かつ salary が 3000 以上の人を選び、name と salary を表示してください。2つの条件は AND でつなぎます。

constraints.name: 条件
constraints.value: department が sales かつ salary が 3000 以上です

starterSql:
SELECT
  name,
  salary
FROM employees
WHERE department = 'sales'
  AND salary >= 3000
ORDER BY name ASC;
solutionSql:
SELECT
  name,
  salary
FROM employees
WHERE department = 'sales'
  AND salary >= 3000
ORDER BY name ASC;
